findings: Past their materials’ limits at their worst moment: Set-up click 3017 MPa in steel against 1200–1800 (The key let go outright); Winding pawls 1509 MPa in steel against 1200–1800 (1.75 N·m on the winding ratchet, The key let go outright); Fusee wheel (great wheel) 369 MPa in brass against 300–450 (The key let go outright).

The mainspring (0.394 mm) fully wound: 3021 MPa on its inner coils, 2702 along it, against its strip’s 2600 MPa: the inner coils, where the strip winds tightest round the arbor, carry more than its average.

The parts past their limits are all at the key let go outright: the fusee runs back onto its click (or pawl) and the blow passes to the maintaining work and the train. Easing the key back keeps them within their limits.
The model’s own mechanism turns 6 arbors of the train at their tooth counts’ ratio, to 0.1 %.
